newsitem.title: FRANCE: CGT union to press Fr Telecom stake sale opposition.
newsitem.headline: CGT union to press Fr Telecom stake sale opposition.

text.p: France's Communist-led CGT trade union said on Friday it would contact other unions in its campaign against the opening up of France Telecom's capital.

The union, which opposes any opening up of capital to private investors, said it had contacted other unions -- some of them are not opposed to such a sale -- and that further contact would be made in the second half of August.

An official source said on Thursday that the new leftwing government could put a minority stake in the telecoms operator up for sale in September, stressing that the move was important for the company's future and did not amount to a continuation of the privatisation policy of its centre-right predecessor.

The finance ministry says no decision has been taken and the source said a decision could be announced as soon as a report was submitted to the government by a specially-appointed state envoy, Michel Delabarre. That report is expected before September 5.
